item.title: Baby Brocolli
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Baby Brocolli
  • Olive oil

Instructions

  • Clean
  • Pan fry
  • Salt, Pepper
  • Stir and cook until some browning
  • Add chilli flakes, splash of lemon juice

item.title: Barbeque Pork Chops
item.description:
Ingredients

Pork

  • 4 thick cut, bone in pork chops
  • 1.5 cups kosher salt
  • 4 quarts water

Spice Rub

  • 1 tbsp dark brown sugar
  • 1 tsp paprika
  • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1/2 tsp ground coriander
  • 1 tsp ground cumin
  • few cracks black pepper

Barbeque Sauce

  • 1/2 cup ketcup
  • half small white onion, grated
  • 1 1/2 tbsp worcestershire sauce
  • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika
  • apple cider vinegar
  • 2 tbsp dijon mustard
  • 1 tbsp dark brown sugar

Instructions

Brine

  • Combine water and salt in a container
  • Submerge Pork
  • Cover and sit for 1-5 hours

Spice Rub

  • Combine all ingredients

Barbeque sauce

  • Add all ingredients
  • Optionally simmer for 30+ minutes

Pork

  • Remove pork chops and dry with paper towels
  • Rub with spice
  • Cook with vegetable oil to 145f internal
  • Remove and clean pan
  • Brush on barbeque sauce
  • Cook again to brown sauce and maintain 145f internal

item.title: Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 2 quart chicken stock

  • 1 cup wild rice

  • 1 1/2 chicken breast

  • 1 cup celery, diced

  • 1 cup carrots, diced

  • 1/2 cup onion, chopped

  • 2 bay leaves

  • 1 tsp dried parsley

  • 3 cloves garlic, minced

  • 1/4 tsp dried thyme

Roux

  • 1/4 cup butter
  • 1/4 cup all‑purpose flour
  • 1 cup half‑and‑half
  • 1 cup milk

Instructions

Prepare

  1. Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
  2. Place them in a slow cooker.
  3. Add everything else

Cook the Soup

  1. Cover and cook on low for 6–8 hours. Less for high heat
  2. Remove the bay leaves.
  3. Take out the chicken breasts, shred them with two forks, and return the shredded chicken to the slow cooker.

Make the Roux

  1. In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
  2. Add the flour, whisk until combined, cook until slightly browned.
  3. Slowly add liquids while mixing
  4. Cook, whisking frequently, until the mixture thickens (about 5 minutes).

Combine and Serve

  1. Stir roux into soup until combined
  2. Adjust seasonings to taste

item.title: Chicken Parmesan
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 4 Skinless chicken breast halves (thickness halved)
  • 2 Large eggs
  • 1 cup panko crumbs
  • 3/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
  • 2 tbsp flour
  • 1/2 cup olive oil
  • 1/2 cup marinara sauce
  • 1/4 cup fresh mozarella
  • 1/4 tbsp chopped basil
  • 2 teaspoons oil

Instructions

Bread crumb mixture

  • Add bread crumbs, salt, pepper, paprika, parmesan to a bowl

Chicken Breasts

  • Butterfly cut chicken breasts
  • Cover with parchment paper and pound smooth and thin
  • Bread the chicken breasts in a flour bowl, egg, panko
  • Lay on sheet and press extra crumbs into chicken

Spaghetti

  • Cook normally
  • Season with olive oil, salt, pepper, parsley, basil leaves
  • Some sauce

Cook Chicken

  • Pan fry with a small layer of oil riding up the sides
  • 2.5 minutes each side
  • Add some butter half way through when edges are cooked
  • Place onto sheet
  • Once all pieces are cooked on sheet, turn broiler on
  • Add marinara sauce and mozarella cheese slices
  • Place into broiler until melted

item.title: Eggnog
item.description:
From Tasting History

Ingredients

  • 10 Large eggs
  • 3/4 Cups sugar
  • 1 1/2 cups brandy (korbel)
  • 1 1/2 cups rye whiskey
  • 1 quart whole milk
  • 2 cups heavy cream
  • 2-3 tsp ground nutmeg

Instructions

Mix

  • Separate egg whites and yolks

  • Beat yolks until pale yellow

  • Add 1/3rd of the sugar at a time and beat until all combined

  • You can continue to add sugar until it stops dissolving. Drizzling from wick should leave a ribbon puddle sort of thing.

item.title: Glazed Carrots
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Carrots or Baby Carrots
  • 2-3 tbps butter
  • 1-2 tbps brown sugar or honey
  • Salt, Pepper
  • Cinnamon, nutmeg, fresh herbs

Instructions

  • Steam until quite tender, 5-7 minutes or so, 5 or less for baby carrots.
  • Pan, melt butter, add sweetener and salt and pepper
  • Toss carrots in for 3-5 minutes until coated
  • Toss extra spices if desired

item.title: Gravy
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Ham pan drippings
  • 2-3 Tablespoons flour per cup of drippings
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Thyme
  • Sage

Instructions

  • Let pan drippings sit for a few minutes for fat to separate
  • Skim off fat
  • Heat drippings in pan to boil
  • Add flour
  • Cook 1-2 minutes
  • Gradually add stock
  • Simmer until thick
  • Season as you go

item.title: Shrimp Scampi
item.description:
Ingredients

Pasta

  • 1 lb Linguini
  • 3 tbps unsalted butter
  • 3 tbps olive oil

Shrimp

  • 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
  • 4 cloves crushed garlic
  • 1/2 cup dry white wine
  • 1 lb deveined shrimp
  • 1 large lemon
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • 3 tbps parsley, chopped

Instructions

Pasta

  • Boil water
  • Cook linguini until it still has a bite but you don’t need to pick it out of your teeth
  • Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water
  • Combine with butter and oil

Shrimp

  • Saute red pepper flakes and garlic in oil until fragrant
  • Deglaze with white wine
  • Simmer until evaporated, about 5 minutes
  • Add shrimp
  • Cook until shrimp is pink but not cooked through, about 3-4 minutes

Combine

  • Add pasta to shrimp pan
  • Add juice of lemon
  • Add salt and pepper
  • Add 1/4 cup pasta water or more until sauce looks smooth
  • Add olive oil
  • Sauce should be thick and creamy, cook down or add pasta water
  • Add parsley and any other desired seasonings

Extras

  • Use extra garlic
  • Dry brine shrimp, see binging with babish video
  • 1 tbps marjoram
  • 1 tbps tarragon

item.title: Stuffing
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Italian bread
  • Onions
  • Celery
  • Carrot
  • Sage
  • Thyme
  • Rosemary
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Chicken Broth

Instructions

  • Let bread go stale or dry out in a warm oven
  • Chop vegetables
  • Cut bread into cubes
  • Combine into large bowl
  • Add 1-2 cups of broth at a time until everything is moist but not soggy
  • Bake 350f covered 30-40 minutes, remove covering in last 10 minutes

item.title: Thanksgiving Ham
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Bone-in, spiral cut, fully cooked ham

Instructions

  • Remove ham from container
  • Place in baking with high walls
  • Cover with foil
  • Bake at 275-300
  • Add water to the bottom of pan
  • 10-12 minutes per pound, approximately 2 hours
  • Target 140f internal
  • Uncover and make glaze according to packet

item.title: Tilapia
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Tilapia fillet
  • Butter
  • Lemon
  • Old Bay Seasoning

Instructions

  • Dry fillet and coat with seasonings
  • Heat butter in pan
  • Cook until 145f internal
  • Sprinkle with lemon juice

item.title: Creamy Zucchini Penne
item.description:
Ingredients

  • One zucchini
  • Garlic
  • One lemon
  • Italian seasoning
  • Penne
  • Cream cheese
  • Chicken stock
  • Parmesan

Instructions

Cook Penne

Bake zucchini at 450F with oil and italian seasoning

Prepare Sauce

  1. Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a saucepan.
  2. Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant.
  3. Stir in cream cheese, chicken stock, grated Parmesan, and pasta water.
  4. Season with salt and pepper.

Combine and Serve

item.title: Sweet Umami Beef Bowl
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 200g White rice
  • 330g Ground beef
  • 330g Carrots
  • 330g cucumber
  • Sriracha
  • Ponzu sauce
  • Lime
  • Onion
  • Scallions

Notes

This recipe made approximately 3 servings.

beef:carrot:cucumber:rice ratio is approximately 1:1:1:2

Instructions

Rice

  • Cook rice with a pinch of salt.
  • Add 1 tbsp butter, scallion greens, and lime zest.

Cucumber

  • Slice cucumber into slim half moons.
  • In a sealable tupperware, combine cucumber, juice from 1/2 lime, 1/4 tsp sugar, and a pinch of salt.
  • Shake frequently to pickle.

Carrots

  • Grate or julienne carrots for desired texture.

Beef

  • Cook diced onion and scallion whites in a pan.
  • Add beef, garlic, and 2 tsp sugar. Cook until the beef is browned.
  • Add ponzu sauce, salt, and pepper to taste.

Topping

  • Mix 2 tsp mayo with a squeeze of lime juice, a pinch of garlic, sriracha, salt, and pepper for a delicious topping.

Combine and serve

item.title: Blanched Asparagus
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Asparagus

Extras

  • Bowl of ice water

Instructions

Prepare Asparagus

  • Cut woody base off
  • Peel base for even thickness

Cook Asparagus

  • Bring salty water to a boil
  • Place asparagus in
  • Cook for 1 to 4 minutes depending on desired doneness
  • Remove and place into ice water
  • Dry with a towel

Sear Asparagus

  • Bring buttered pan to medium heat
  • Asparagus in
  • Add salt, pepper, butter, garlic
  • Roll around until desired color forms on asparagus
  • Remove and serve

item.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 2 cups heavy whipping cream
  • 1/2 cups fresh grated parmesan
  • Fettuccine

Instructions

Cook Alfredo

Make Sauce

  • Pour cream into a pan and bring to simmer
  • Slowly combine parmesan until combined
  • Continue to simmer until desired thickness
  • Combine pasta
  • Serve

item.title: Ham and Cheese Crepes
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Crepes (see Savory Crepes Recipe)
  • Ham
  • Cheese (many kinds work well)

Instructions

Prepare Ingredients

Cut ham and cheese into cubes.

Create Savory Crepes

Create savory crepes as seen in the Savory Crepes Recipe

Assemble Crepes

Load half the crepe with ham and cheese, then roll it up.

Cook Crepes

Place the rolled-up crepe into a hot buttered pan with the end of the crepe on the bottom. Cook until the cheese melts and the crepe browns slightly. Flip and do the same on the other side.
